P. S. |display-authors=etal |title=A phase I, needle free, dose escalation clinical trial of pEVAC-PS, a candidate pan-Sarbecovirus Vaccine |journal=Journal of Infection |date=18 May 2026 |volume=92 |issue=6 |article-number=106759 |doi=10.1016/j.jinf.2026.106759 |pmid=42155675|doi-access=free }}</ref>
